title: Veloura Atelier
tagline: A full beauty storefront with its own admin
description: A complete beauty and skincare shop for the Bangladeshi market: browse, product detail, cart, checkout, order tracking, customer accounts, printable invoices and a journal — plus the admin dashboard the owner actually runs it from.
highlights: Ten customer-facing screens, from catalogue to order tracking
Admin dashboard with orders, catalogue and courier booking
Mobile-first — built for phones before desktop
